test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 13 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A train covers a distance of 225 km in 2(1)/(2) hours at a uniform speed. The time taken by the train (in hours) to cover a distance of 630 km at the same speed is:
solution:
**Given:**

Time is taken by train to cover 225 km = 2(1)/(2) hours

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance/Speed

**Calculation:**

Time is taken by train to cover 225 km = 2(1)/(2) hours = 5/2 hours

Speed of the train = 225 ÷ (5/2) = 90 km/h

Time required to cover 630 km = 630/90 = 7 hours

**∴ The time is taken by the train (in hours) to cover a distance of 630 km at the same speed is 7 hours**
